name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
summary: A Dark Iron dwarf in Gnomeregan carries a ring caked in toxic filth and hardened muck. The Sparklematic 5200 in the Clean Zone dormitory can scour it clean and reveal its markings.

sections.title: A Relic Beneath the Muck
sections.body: Fighting leaves Gnomeregan's corridors coated in toxic sludge, oil, and radioactive fallout. Dark Iron dwarves who infiltrate the city carry trinkets fouled by that filth. One ring bears a crust that ordinary washing cannot remove. Beneath it, the metal may be copper, gold, or junk.

sections.title: The Sparklematic 5200
sections.body: The Sparklematic 5200 in the Clean Zone dormitory takes coins, scours fouled items, and returns them polished and wrapped with a bow. Cleaning the ring reveals a city's seal and initials engraved inside the band. Those markings begin Return of the Ring, a journey toward restitution.

faq.q: Where do you find the Grime-Encrusted Ring?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves inside Gnomeregan carry the ring.

faq.q: How do you clean the ring?
aliases: how to clean grime encrusted ring
faq.answer: Take the ring to the Sparklematic 5200 in Gnomeregan's Clean Zone dormitory. Pay the required coin fee, and the machine scours away the hardened muck.

faq.q: What happens after the ring is cleaned?
aliases: what do i do with clean ring
faq.answer: The Sparklematic returns the restored ring in a neatly packaged box, with its personal engravings revealed. This begins Return of the Ring, which leads you to seek the ring's original owner.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde adventurers can clean the ring with the Sparklematic 5200. Later steps send Horde players to an engineer in Orgrimmar instead of back to Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is the ring wrapped in a gift box after cleaning?
faq.answer: The Sparklematic 5200 scours away sludge and grime, then packages each cleaned item and ties on a decorative bow, all with gnomish whimsy.
Several Sparklematic units line the wall in the Clean Zone dormitory. Only the one on the left as you enter by the stairs, near the friendly gnomes, works for the ring.

angles.text: The Sparklematic 5200 shows gnomish engineering at work, combining industrial solvent-scrubbing with an automatic gift wrapper.
As a gnome, you know that even as your city fell, its inventors built sanitation machines that finish dangerous wash cycles with a cheerful bell and a bow.
As a dwarf, you can see that an infiltrating Dark Iron dwarf may have scavenged the ring from Ironforge or from gnomish victims during Gnomeregan's fall.
